description: This file defines data structures and functions related to profiling tensor shapes and managing shape symbols within the PyTorch JIT runtime, including classes for handling profiling records, shape symbol tables, and set partitioning helpers.

classes.name: SetPartitioningHelper
classes.description: Manages the partitioning of shape symbol sets to maintain consistent shape representations across profiling runs.

classes.name: ShapeSymbolTable
classes.description: Assigns and manages dimension values for shape symbols, ensuring consistency and correctness during shape profiling.

classes.name: ProfilingRecord
classes.description: Encapsulates profiling data for a computation graph, including methods for instrumentation and profile node management.

methods.name: partitionSetByDimension
methods.description: Partitions a set of dimension locations associated with a shape symbol into subsets based on a new dimension size.

methods.name: getSetForSymbol
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the set of dimension-to-shape-symbol mappings for a given shape symbol.

methods.name: isBound
methods.description: Checks if a shape symbol has an assigned dimension value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the dimension value assigned to a shape symbol.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns a dimension value to a shape symbol.

methods.name: bindSymbolicShapes
methods.description: Attempts to bind a list of new sizes to shape symbols, ensuring consistency.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Checks if the profiling record is ready for use.

methods.name: createProfileIValueNode
methods.description: Creates a profiling node for a given input value or list of values.

methods.name: createProfileNode
methods.description: Creates a profiling node with a specified function and inputs.

methods.name: instrumentBlock
methods.description: Instruments a block of the computation graph for profiling.

methods.name: insertShapeProfile
methods.description: Inserts shape profiling nodes into the graph.
